name: grok-api
specialty: Pay-as-you-go Grok on its own xAI key: the cheapest per output token for reviews, and the security-review fallback.
notes: Runs `grok -p -m grok-build-0.1` in plan mode with Bash, Edit, Write and MCP tools denied and no subagents; reviewer and security-review fallback only, never a builder. The existing `grok` profile stays on the Grok Build subscription.
XAI_API_KEY is set only in this child's environment. Use a dedicated xAI key with a spend cap.
Every seat runs with GROK_WORKFLOWS=0 (see the grok profile): --no-subagents does not stop background workflows.
